notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI has no duel support at all. The only match for 'Duel' in the repo is an enum string in Net/SpellCastResultNames.cs. None of the duel opcodes (SMSG_DUEL_REQUESTED/COUNTDOWN/COMPLETE/WINNER/INBOUNDS/OUTOFBOUNDS, CMSG_DUEL_ACCEPTED/CANCELLED) are handled - matching the registry's 1/16 opcode hit.
